formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (e : Point) (f : Point) (BC : Line) (EF : Line) (AD : Line) (BF : Line), ((formTriangle a b c BC (LineEndpoints BC) (LineEndpoints BC)) ∧ (formTriangle d e f EF (LineEndpoints EF) (LineEndpoints EF)) ∧ (|(b─c)| = |(e─f)|) ∧ (Line.intersectsCircle AD (Circle.mk a)) ∧ (Line.intersectsCircle BF (Circle.mk b)) ∧ (Line.intersectsCircle AD (Circle.mk d)) ∧ (Line.intersectsCircle BF (Circle.mk e))) → (Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:e:f)

nl_statement: Triangles which are on equal bases and between the same parallels are equal to one another. Let $ABC$ and $DEF$ be triangles on the equal bases $BC$ and $EF$, and between the same parallels $BF$ and $AD$. I say that triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DEF$.  <prf> Thus, triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DEF$.Thus, triangles which are on equal bases and between the same parallels are equal to one another.
